simulator.note: Boots as an M3602B board (chips/m3602.py, lemontree_decoder.py, run_dump_x4_220_app_starts.py, run_dump_x4_220_capture_screen.py): the bootloader communicates with the external Lemontree front-panel and EuP standby microcontroller at I2C 0x28 over bit-banged SCL = GPIO 62 (0xB80000D4 bit 30) and SDA = GPIO 171 (legacy third GPIO bank 0xB80000E8 bit 11) using 8-byte CRC-16/XMODEM frames (37 bootloader transactions + 3 application transactions: wakeup query, IR wake programming, and 7-segment display updates " ON " -> "    " -> " on "), prints "APP  init ok / size:0x207211", unpacks maincode(AV) into RAM and starts the application.  The application initialises the ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33 and Airoha AV2011 tuner at I2C 0x60 on SCB1, initialises its NVM key/control database over SPI, and renders its Lemontree OSD through GeM3602 (48+ GE commands).

desc: Opticum HD X4 220 (System ID 06020200) firmware 1.3.37 with the "Lemontree" PS GUI (2011-02-24) on a 4 MB SPI flash for the ALi M3602B Full HD DVB-S2 satellite receiver.

Uses an external Lemontree EuP standby and 4-digit 7-segment front-panel microcontroller at I2C 0x28 on GPIO 62 / 171 (CRC-16/XMODEM protocol), an ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33, and an Airoha AV2011 tuner at I2C 0x60.
